title: Add sunset and sunrise times to weather data
line: The Weather widget now shows today's sunrise and sunset times in its details list.
explanation: The weather ions already compute or receive sunrise and sunset, but only use them to choose day or night icons; nothing in the widget's QML ever displayed them, and only some providers (DWD, Environment Canada) send them at all. The widget now computes today's sunrise and sunset from the station's latitude and longitude with KHolidays::SunEvents (the same code the ions use for night icons) and adds Sunrise and Sunset rows to the details list next to pressure, humidity and wind. The rows are hidden when the station has no coordinates or the sun doesn't rise or set that day (polar night or day).

commits.message:
applets/weather: show sunrise and sunset times

The widget only used sunrise and sunset internally to pick day or night
icons, so there was no way to see them. Compute them from the station's
coordinates for every provider and list them in the details view.

BUG: 521202

media.caption: Weather widget for Rome on master: details list shows pressure, humidity and wind only
With the fix: Sunrise 7:06 AM and Sunset 4:44 PM listed under wind speed (correct for Rome on 21 Nov)
Longyearbyen during polar night: no sunrise or sunset that day, so the two rows are hidden

review.text: Computing sunrise/sunset from the station coordinates with KHolidays::SunEvents is the right call since most providers don't send them, and the media show correct times plus the polar-night case. But the DetailsView bindings call QDateTime::currentDateTime() once and only re-evaluate when the station changes, so after midnight in a long-running plasmashell the rows can keep showing the previous day's times.
changes: Make the sunrise/sunset bindings re-evaluate per day, e.g. pass the observation/update time (or a date that changes with each forecast update) into Util.sunrise/sunset instead of using currentDateTime() inside a binding that never refreshes.
